atoms.b: There are ((++a_few no)) different types of pedestrian crossings, which you should ((++always never)) try to use.
Pedestrian crossings with traffic lights have a box with a red and ((++green pink)) man, which tells you when it is safe to ((++go eat)).
Zebra crossings have black and white ((++stripes spots)). Cars will slow down and ((++stop fly)) when they see pedestrians waiting to cross here.

instruction.text: A pelican crossing has a box with a red and green man on the other side of the road to you. Which man shows that you can cross? Select the correct image.

feedback.end: You often have to press a button for the green man to show. Be patient and never start crossing if the green man is flashing.

instruction.text: A puffin crossing has a box with a red and green man on the same side of the road as you. Select the button you need to press.

feedback.end: The green man does not flash here. Cross quickly when you see the green man, but do not run.

instruction.text: This is a zebra crossing, where cars will stop for you to cross. Answer the questions.

atoms.a: If you see a car coming, when should you cross?

feedback.end: You should always make sure the cars have seen you and have time to slow down and stop before you cross. Don’t cross when the cars are still moving!

instruction.text: This zebra crossing has an island. Select it to learn more.

feedback.end: Make sure to stop at the island and look around and listen before you cross again. Treat each half of the crossing as separate crossings, and only cross when vehicles have stopped.

instruction.text: This is a railway level crossing. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: These crossings might have gates or ((++barriers planes)). They might also have ((++alarms cows)) and warning lights.
You must ((++not quickly)) go past the lights when they are flashing, when the barriers are being ((++lowered painted)) or when there is an alarm sounding.
Only cross when the lights have gone out and when the ((++barriers balloons)) are up. Make sure to stop, ((++look sing)) and listen before you cross.

instruction.text: What are the rules you should always follow when crossing any kind of road? Select the three correct answers.

feedback.end: Great! No matter what type of crossing you use, the main thing to remember is to always stay alert and be careful.
